headlines.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Stock May Be Fully Priced As AI Risks Hit Software
headlines.summary: ServiceNow has seen its share price slide sharply over the past year, even as debate around AI, cybersecurity and workflow automation has intensified. With the stock under pressure, the key issue for you is whether today’s valuation is still supported by the company’s earnings power. Over the past 12 months the share price has fallen 43.3%, which puts the spotlight squarely on whether the current earnings base can justify where the stock trades now.

headlines.title: Anthropic falls below IPO price as Nvidia gives back gains
headlines.summary: In this edition of Sozzi Unleashed: At The Close, Brian Sozzi sorts through "reality trading" as Nvidia slides nearly 7% after Monday's 31% surge and Anthropic falls below its $83 IPO price less than a week after the biggest offering in history. GCG Advisory Partners' Bill Gunderson makes the case that Nvidia is the cheapest growth stock in the market at nine times forward earnings and names Nvidia and Eli Lilly as his top picks for 2027. Brian breaks down Dell's blowout quarter and $132 billion AI backlog, and HPE CEO Antonio Neri joins to explain the company's raised outlook, why it refuses to finance neoclouds, and whether server margins have peaked. Brian closes by arguing the AI trade is reaching consumers' wallets, pointing to Best Buy's strongest comparable sales growth in five years.

description: ServiceNow, Inc. provides cloud-based solution for digital workflows in the North America, Brazil, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Asia Pacific, and internationally. The company provides asset management, integrated risk management, IT service management, Operational Technology management, Security Operations, strategic portfolio management, IT operations management products; customer service management product; field service management applications; and sales and order management services. It also offers human resources delivery; legal and contract operations; workplace service delivery products; app engine product; automation engine; platform privacy and security product; and source-to-pay operations. In addition, the company provides RaptorDB, a database built to manage workloads at scale; ServiceNow Impact that provides customers with software tools, guided plans, and AI-driven recommendations; customer support; and workflow data fabric. It serves government, financial services, healthcare and life science, manufacturing, Public Sector, retail, technology, and Telecom sectors through service providers and resale partners. The company has a strategic collaboration with Cohesity, Inc. to develop, operate, and safeguard autonomous AI agents and data with enterprise-grade reliability; and with ServiceNow to Advance Ai-Powered Solution for Mission-Critical Infrastructure Monitoring. The company was formerly known as Service-now.com and changed its name to ServiceNow, Inc. in May 2012. ServiceNow, Inc. has a strategic alliance with Accenture for integrated risk management and third-party risk management solutions, and with Tech Mahindra to validate and deliver production-ready, industry-specific enterprise AI and automation solutions at scale. ServiceNow, Inc. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.
